# MKK Shuttle

MKK Shuttle provides airport shuttle transfers between Tokyo airports and the Myoko area.

Website: https://myokoshuttle.com  
Contact: bookings@myokoshuttle.com  
Service type: Airport shuttle / transport booking service  
Languages: English and Japanese

## Services

- Online shuttle booking
- Airport transfers from Narita Airport
- Airport transfers from Haneda Airport
- Transfers to Myoko Kogen and surrounding resorts
- Secure online payment
- Customer booking management
- Online cancellation and refund handling

## Main Service Areas

- Narita Airport
- Haneda Airport
- Myoko Kogen
- Akakura Onsen
- Akakura Kanko Resort
- Shin Akakura
- Ikenotaira
- Madarao
- Tangram
- Lotte Arai Resort
- Iiyama Station

## Booking

Customers can book online, pay securely by card, manage bookings from their account, and cancel according to the cancellation policy.

## Cancellation Policy

- 21+ days before departure: 10% cancellation fee
- 20–14 days before departure: 30% cancellation fee
- 13–8 days before departure: 50% cancellation fee
- 7 days or less before departure: 100% cancellation fee

Refunds are calculated automatically where applicable.

## Contact

For booking help or support, contact:

bookings@myokoshuttle.com
